stage: S1-D4 single relative-order proposal verified by original RGB sources
prior_input: Saved raw_relative only from fixed Small, never aligned_depth or oracle assets
candidate_membership: exactly all original D1 positive pixels; original depths copied unless accepted; no point growth/deletion
anchors: Original D2 tight UV/depth/lower/upper, maximum256 selected by stable row-major evenly spaced indices inclusive endpoints
farther_bound: raw target <= raw anchor - margin: lower bound q80 of those D2 lower depths, only if >=4 distinct anchor blocks
closer_bound: raw target >= raw anchor + margin: upper bound q20 of those D2 upper depths, only if >=4 distinct anchor blocks
missing_bound: inherited camera-derived near/far on that side; both missing means no proposal
proposal_eligibility: old depth outside valid nonempty interval by more than1e-6
depth_grid: same inclusive camera-derived near/far inverse-depth grid as original RGB-MVS; no GT alignment or clamp
fit_sources: Original six source indices first4; native source_cost and same patch_features5; average best3 of4
held_sources: Original six source indices last2; these are acceptance sources, NOT independent GT
proposal: minimum finite fit cost within interval, stable first-grid tie; empty means no proposal; no extra continuous refinement
acceptance: new fit cost<=old+1e-6; both finite held costs<=old+1e-6; at least one held cost<old-1e-6; original finite positive depths otherwise unchanged
evaluation: Frozen independent static GT only after outputs; all original candidates and full visible/thin ray denominators, thin intersect observed static visible; fixed0/24/72 images; source/input/hash/membership/unchanged-depth audit
